'''Yuleph Phan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Yuleph Phan was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Phan was appointed as the [[Master of Rituals]].<ref name="TOR" />
